dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Huh? Did I say that word? Hahah...

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Uh, what are you doing? Wait, please! Put your sword away. I—I will tell you everything I know!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: I'll be honest. I was indeed a thief once. But just when I was about to quit my job, all of my savings were stolen!

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: This is probably what I deserve... But if someone could help me retrieve my money, I'll be a good person and atone for the rest of my life.

dialogues.speaker: Nishiguchi
dialogues.text: Ah, should I ask Bantan Sango Detective Agency for help?
